items.label: SJ Semiconductor half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-20-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Half-year report, technology: in H1 2026 the company completed process development

set.signal: Half-year report, technology: in H1 2026 the company completed process development of a 6x-reticle ultra-large silicon-bridge chiplet integration solution (SmartPoser-BD; embedded silicon bridge, high-density TMV and multi-layer high-density RDL) for next-generation higher-compute chips; its micro-bump 3DIC platform SmartPoser-3DIC-BP reached volume production; the hybrid-bonding 3DIC platform SmartPoser-3DIC-HB (pitch of 10um and below) has completed full-flow verification and is being developed for C2W and W2W; SmartPoser-RDL is in small-volume trial production. Its TSV-interposer 2.5D platform SmartPoser-Si is in large-scale volume production with interposers up to about 3x reticle, integration of 10 or more functional chips and large FCBGA packages of 75mm*75mm and above; the company says it is one of the earliest and largest 2.5D producers in mainland China, with no generational technology gap to the global leaders (company's claim).

items.reason: The report gives the SmartPoser-Si large-FCBGA package size as 75mm*75mm AND ABOVE (die 50mm*50mm and above), not 'up to' 75mm*75mm.
items.evidence: 支持封装的芯片（晶粒）尺寸可达50mm*50mm 以上，对应封装成品尺寸可达75mm*75mm 以上
